shared_elements: bearded male head with elaborate coiffure
stylized rendering of hair/beard in regular rows of curls
procession or figures facing the same direction
justification: Both depict bearded male figures in strict profile carved in low relief, with hair and beards rendered as regularized rows of stylized curls and heads covered by patterned headgear, a fairly specific shared convention. But A is a small-scale multi-figure procession scene with a led camel, offering-bearers and a rosette border band, whereas B is a single monumental head filling the field with no accompanying animals, procession or ornamental border.
